summary: Transportation & Logistics Systems filed an 8-K disclosing completion of its reverse triangular merger of TLSS Reverse PGS, LLC into Patriot Glass Solutions, LLC, with PGS surviving, effective November 1, 2026, following a Member Interest and Asset Exchange Agreement dated April 1, 2026 and five amendments. PGS manager Michael Wanke held a 20% membership interest; terms and consideration are not stated in this excerpt. The filing spans items covering entry into a material agreement, completion of acquisition, unregistered equity sales, control changes, officer changes and shell-company status, signaling a transformative combination. Watch closing mechanics, post-close ownership split and any residual closing-statement disputes.
